title: Pork and vegetable dumplings
methods: Mix together the flour, water and half the salt into a dough. Knead the dough for 5 minutes then leave to  prove for 10 minutes.
Knead the dough again until smooth, prove for another 10 minutes, then knead for a third time before rolling out thin dumpling wrappers.
Meanwhile, in a bowl, mix together the pork, mushrooms, carrots and chives.
Add a splash of water, the corn starch, white pepper, the remaining salt, oyster sauce, chicken stock sesame oil and vegetable oil and mix together.
Stuff 1 tablespoon of the pork mixture into a dumpling wrapper, seal with a bit of water and pleat the edges of the dumpling.
Put the dumplings into a bamboo steamer in batches an cook for 10 minutes.
Serve the dumplings with dark vinegar, soy sauce and chilli sauce.
